semiconductor_relevance: Medium — ProSpectral develops photonics technology that utilizes semiconductor processes for imaging applications, but it does not primarily operate as a semiconductor supplier.
summary: ProSpectral Ltd is an innovation-driven photonics company specializing in the development of snapshot spectral imagers for materials identification through computer vision. Their technology leverages modified off-the-shelf image sensors with nanostructured filters, enabling targeted imaging solutions that enhance data accuracy and reduce noise.
capabilities: Customizable imaging solutions for specific applications
